+ Shiba Inu (SHIB): Inspired by Dogecoin, Shiba Inu has a strong community and has seen significant price movements. It aims to create an ecosystem that includes a decentralized exchange (ShibaSwap).

+Dogecoin (DOGE): Created as a joke based on the “Doge” meme, Dogecoin has gained popularity and is now widely traded. It has been used for tipping content creators and fundraising for charitable causes.
